plans.objective: [DIM: optimization] The apparent flatness of N_c(w) for rigid families is an optimization artifact: small networks get stuck in local minima and fail to find the low-dimensional solution, making the problem appear "fat" (capacity required) when it is actually rigid.

steps.description: Implement the family function defining rigid (low-dimensional) and fat (high-dimensional) constraint families for the capacity scan experiment. The rigid family will be a linear constraint (1D solution space), while the fat family will be a sinusoidal constraint with multiple parameters (higher-dimensional solution space). This implements the core scientific logic needed to test whether small networks get stuck in local minima, making rigid problems appear "fat" (requiring more capacity) than they truly are.
